result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback: the cap is mutual and tied to 12 months’ charges (with the existing $100,000 floor), the consequential-damages exclusion is mutual, all required fallback carve-outs—and the preferred additional carve-outs—are uncapped, and payment obligations are outside the Customer cap. It does not reach the preferred $1,000,000 floor. The standalone carve-out for any loss of or damage to Customer data caused by IBM is broader than the playbook, which requires uncapped treatment for breaches of data-protection or security obligations, and therefore materially changes the existing data-loss allocation beyond what is needed. Drafting is generally clear, but the retained duplicated/fragmented subsection structure and the margin comment’s incomplete description of the added carve-outs reduce quality.
